sources.title: GitHub Copilot price table (github/docs models-and-pricing.yml)
sources.quote: This file defines per-token pricing for AI models available in GitHub Copilot.

sources.title: Anthropic: Prompt caching, pricing (1-hour cache writes)
sources.quote: Cache write tokens with a 1-hour TTL are 2 times the base input tokens price.

sources.title: Anthropic: Prompt caching, pricing (prompt-length tiers)
sources.quote: On a model priced by prompt length, cache reads and cache writes count toward a request's prompt length.

sources.title: GitHub Docs: Models and pricing for GitHub Copilot
sources.quote: Anthropic models include a cache write cost in addition to cached input.

sources.title: GitHub Docs: Models and pricing for GitHub Copilot (Gemini 4 Argon promotion)
sources.quote: Gemini 4 Argon is available at the promotional pricing of $2.00 per 1M input tokens, $0.10 per 1M cached input tokens, and $10.00 per 1M output tokens until December 1, 2026.

sources.title: GitHub Docs: Models and pricing for GitHub Copilot (Gemini 3.8 Flash promotion)
sources.quote: Gemini 3.8 Flash is available at the promotional pricing of $0.75 per 1M input tokens, $0.075 per 1M cached input tokens, and $3.75 per 1M output tokens through December 31, 2026.

sources.title: GitHub Docs: Models and pricing for GitHub Copilot
sources.quote: Earlier OpenAI models have no cache write cost.
